title: Tekken 3, native
intro: Tekken3Recompiled turns the PlayStation game into a native program for Windows, macOS, Linux and Android: no emulator in between.

chapters.title: Built from your disc
chapters.body: The hub builds it from your own Tekken 3 USA disc (SLUS-00402). The first build takes several minutes and needs about 4 GB free.

chapters.title: Jun Kazama
chapters.body: With both Tekken 3 arcade sets set up as well, Jun Kazama is added to the game.

chapters.title: Its own launcher
chapters.body: Play opens the game's launcher, where you set up controllers, memory cards and mods before starting.
